program.name: Carry Day
program.subject: Grip & forearms
program.blurb: Circuits built around carrying heavy things: farmer carries and suitcase marches between lifts.
program.about: Circuits built around picking heavy things up and carrying them. Every round has a farmer carry or a suitcase march between a squat or hinge and a pull, so the grip works while the rest of you does too. Rounds are steady rather than frantic. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds time and reps.
